column4: the census descriptor cannot carry the donor pattern index: the index key needs contract, structure and logic roots, the census is the catalogue dimension only (its README hands the structural dimension to the L-Hash clustering); measure before deciding: a span join showed the exact dimension IS representable (exactRoot == sourceSha256 on 8,261 / 8,261 span-equal atoms, 7,170 identical exact groups) while projection groups are not (36 of 516 multi-member groups), so Phase A stops at NEC and Phase B keeps census catalogue pattern + exact digest

the census --semantic mode refuses any source that declares an enum constant (IllegalArgumentException: unbound semantic source span), 33 of the 353 m3/collections + m3/algorithms files; run it once per file (phase-a/CensusPerFile.java) so one refusal does not hide the rest, and keep it as an open item of the census owner (the gate's atomize inherits the refusal)

column4: a naming stage inside the recipe (import of make/m3/tooling/jdk-naming/jdk_naming.py, rewrite_text on every relocated file) gives the jdk_naming fixed point by construction instead of one LITERAL row per token; NAMING rows then record only the schema-relevant renames, and the recipe checks them (donor token in a donor file, target token in a relocated file, donor token in none): CANONICAL_SYNEXIA_METHOD_RECIPE_NOT_EXECUTED changed the admitted queue schema of M3OpenJdkAtomPatternGate and M3_JDK_BINARY_IMAGE_V2_... the runtime-root digest domain

column4: adapter changes are REWRITE rows (rewrites/<name>.before replaced by rewrites/<name>.after on the donor bytes, occurrence count declared and enforced) so the body of every relocated file is the donor's plus declared rows; a per-file SCOPED_TYPE row reproduces a donor derivation (the long-set baseline = pre-atom owner renamed) without renaming the same type in the other files

column4: the donor planner's plan(...) sorts targets by (logical path, atom id, envelope root) while the gate seam keeps the caller's order (the planner's planInDependencyOrder contract); the first relocated test run failed the waiver case because its first target was no longer the JNI one: the test plan helper sorts like the donor planner (REWRITE gate-test-plan) and the verdict differential builds the relocated Plan from the donor plan's root and order

git archive of the donor tree converts *.c / *.cpp to CRLF (the donor's text attributes), while the fixture custody manifest pins the LF blob bytes: the donor verify.py refused its own m3jni.c; donor fixture crates are written from git show blobs (differential.sh), never from an archive or checkout

column4: Git Bash rewrites /m3/... arguments (git sparse-checkout add, wsl -e bash /mnt/...) into C:/Program Files/Git/...: pass sparse patterns with --stdin and run wsl with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1; javac -sourcepath takes the source root (.../src/main/java), not the package directory
